structure.unit: Regulation of Medical Care Facilities and Services
Prescribed Pediatric Extended Care Center Licensing

law.catch_line: (Effective July 1, 2026) Retaliation against reports of child or adult abuse or neglect
law.text: No Center may retaliate in any manner against any person who in good faith reports adult or child abuse or neglect pursuant to Chapter 15 (§ 63.2-1501 et seq.) or Article 2 (§ 63.2-1603 et seq.) of Chapter 16 of Title 63.2.
